supersedes: TRACKA-HL-EARLY4H-2025H1 (sealed prereg 134503Z). Estimator-only successor: the sealed rv result (NOT_MET) is not re-tested and the sealed prereg is not modified. Only the liq estimator/model form changes (Poisson/quasi-Poisson log-link IRLS) because the sealed unregularized linear-in-log model was numerically unstable on the Oct-2025 funding spike.

universe.selection_rule: named ex ante by label activity and liquidity; no survivor substitution
universe.concentration_note: BTC+ETH are ~63% of events and ~84% of notional; per-coin reporting is mandatory and no PASS may be driven by one coin.

targets.definition: next-24h observed liquidation notional USD (t1_liq), QLIKE loss. Only this target is tested in this campaign.

B1.note: RV-only baseline; no funding information, no persistence lag.

C1.note: signed_funding = fundingRate; abs_funding_trailing_pct90 = abs_fund_pct (90-obs trailing rank, >=30 obs).

C2.form: HAR-RV + funding + premium log-link Poisson/quasi-Poisson GLM

estimator.prediction: conditional mean mu = exp(X beta); no exp-of-unbounded-linear-predictor extrapolation beyond IRLS convergence
estimator.numerical_safeguards: eta clipped to [-30, 30]; mu floored at 1e-12 only to avoid division by zero; IRLS capped at 100 iterations with step-halving if the Poisson deviance increases. These are numerical, not model tuning.

contrasts.multiple_testing: Holm across the full declared contrast family
contrasts.direction: QLIKE lower is better; diff = QLIKE(C2) - QLIKE(B1); PASS needs mean diff < 0

metric_scope: evaluated on rows with t1_liq > 0, identical to the sealed campaign _design/evaluate filtering and to src/volatility/eval.py (non-positive y or yhat are skipped). Zero-liq rows are therefore excluded from both fitting and loss; QLIKE is undefined for y=0.

splits.note: Test blocks are complete 30-day spans inside 2025-07..2025-10 with >=1-day purge between train/validation/test boundaries. Identical to the sealed 134503Z layout.

inference.method: block bootstrap over complete 30-day UTC blocks

numerical_stability.reason: A per-row QLIKE above 1e6 means a prediction is many orders of magnitude below the target (mean QLIKE is a numerical artifact, not an economic signal). Same guard as the corrected sealed eval.

missingness_policy: missing stays missing; no forward fill; no synthetic labels; listwise deletion within each model's feature set.
